2.88.11
Chart.ChartCategoryHierarchy
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Chart.ChartCategoryHierarchy element specifies the hierarchy of category members in a
Chart. This element MUST be specified. This element is of type ChartHierarchy.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.ChartCategoryHierarchy element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.ChartCategoryHierarchy element.
 <xsd:element name="ChartCategoryHierarchy" type="ChartHierarchyType" />
